'''Xanai Sowan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] aboard the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Mourning Glory]]''.<ref name="hapan" />

The ship was captured by the [[Hapan]]s during a trip through the [[Transitory Mists]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Grov Bricker]] and [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] [[Isolder|Kelan Faal]] were taken to ''[[Star Home]]'' where they were sentenced to be executed, while the rest of the crew including Sowan was sent to a Hapan prison [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The captain and the crew were eventually released when Faal turned out to be [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]], who was being sought out by the [[Queen Mother]].<ref name="hapan" />
